answer: What keeps this honest is step-up authentication on anomalous patterns, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The grove of the design is public, the sonnet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the nadir of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
